items.title: August implant leftovers are gone and build configs pass an integrity check (.cursor, HANDOFF.md, hidden push-script ignores, postcss/vite/tailwind, lifecycle scripts)

verified.head: ba9534a77bea6048369dc3e0753679980edbcf4e
verified.note: Beyond the gate run I confirmed postcss.config.js, vite.config.ts and tailwind.config.js are byte-identical to the pre-implant blobs (ceb0925^), package.json has no install lifecycle scripts, there is no tracked or on-disk .cursor/, HANDOFF.md, .githooks/, state/, branch_structure.json or temp push script and no core.hooksPath or .git/hooks entry, and both quote styles of the loader marker are in the indicator list (the real ceb0925 payload used the double-quoted form and also trips the size, eval/spawn, network and long-line checks). Residual: the gate is heuristic (exact substrings; the eval/network checks cover only the five root config names, not e.g. .postcssrc*) and is not wired into CI; the four-file exemption is acceptable because nothing builds or imports those files; origin/main still tracks .cursor/, HANDOFF.md and the hidden .gitignore block until this branch merges.

items.title: intake-routing-apply accepts only the service role or an accepted member of the target organisation

verified.head: ba9534a77bea6048369dc3e0753679980edbcf4e
verified.note: Read orgRole.ts, serviceRole.ts and the handler: the guard runs before any service-role read, the organisation id comes only from the body and target rows are re-checked against it, an empty service key returns 500 before the guard, the anon/publishable key and forged service_role JWTs fall through to auth.getUser and get 401, pending invites and other-organisation memberships get 403, the ranking matches require_role (0210) and the org_role enum (0039), all backend callers (bills-extract, bank-csv-import, bank-sync, automation-worker and also ingest/handlers.ts) send the exact service-role bearer, and deno check on index.ts passes. Residual: the tests exercise auth.ts with fakes rather than the HTTP handler, and a membership-lookup error message is echoed in the 500 body.

items.title: staged-entities-enrich-sonar, bank-statement-extract, crm-pnl-sync-push and ato-lodge refuse unauthenticated calls

verified.head: ba9534a77bea6048369dc3e0753679980edbcf4e
verified.note: Read all four handlers: each guard runs before any table read, Groq/Perplexity/CRM call or config-health output; enrich-sonar takes the organisation only from the body and caps batches at 25x10; Triage.tsx and BankStatementImport.tsx send the user session token and automation-worker sends the service-role bearer to crm-pnl-sync-push; deno check on all four index.ts files and the ato-lodge handler tests pass. Residual: bank-statement-extract and ato-lodge accept any signed-in user and public sign-up is enabled, so Groq credit is still spendable by anyone who registers (no membership check or rate limit); the enrich-sonar persist step (pre-existing) updates staged_entities by the model-returned id without restricting to the batch ids or the organisation; the vitest wiring test is only a source-order scan.

items.title: Payment-run, ABA export, mark-paid, super-batch and termination functions require an accepted admin or owner
Xero and Gmail OAuth state is signed, bound to the user and mandatory on callback
Writes to money tables (payees, bills, invoices, journals, period locks, employees, payment runs) need an accountant or admin role; viewers are read-only
CI uses least-privilege permissions, SHA-pinned actions and a deploy job separate from build
Hardening: CORS allow-list, constant-time secret checks, bundled pdf.js worker, cron secrets in headers, generic error responses
Pay runs calculate wages from the base hourly rate, not the loaded cost rate
Super defaults to the statutory rate (12%) and a pay run never applies less than the SG rate for the pay date
PAYG withholding uses the financial year of the pay date and fails loudly instead of returning $0 when no table applies
FY2026-27 PAYG withholding tables match the ATO schedule (NAT 1004) worked examples
